create.title: Bettin--Chandee and Wright Kloosterman-fraction source audit
create.statement_tex: Bettin--Chandee arXiv:1502.00769v1 Theorem 1, Remark 1, and Corollary 1 and Wright arXiv:2604.25177v2 Theorem 2.1 are source-audited. Bettin--Chandee Theorem 1 has arbitrary independent dyadic coefficients, (m,n)=1, phase e(vartheta a mbar/n), and one outer absolute value; its proof requires the source-safe reading vartheta in Z minus {0}, while Remark 1 permits the printed C1 phase perturbation. Corollary 1 is a fixed nonzero determinant asymptotic with its printed main term and error. Wright Theorem 2.1 has phase e(vartheta a mbar/(nR_0)), (m,nR_0)=1, M<<N^2, R_0<<M^C, arbitrary independent coefficients, and integral nonzero vartheta. Its printed third term has A^(-1/20), whereas the final proof line has the stronger A^(-3/10); the weaker printed theorem is accepted, and the common fifth term is decisive in the project maps. Wright Corollary 2.2 is a modulus sum of individual absolute discrepancies for a fixed nonzero coprime residue, divisor-bounded independent convolution coefficients, a Siegel--Walfisz sequence, a principal subtraction, and one of its printed size regions. Withdrawn arXiv:2601.00292 supplies no theorem.
create.next_action: Use only the exact audited statements and their printed hypotheses. Keep the Wright third-term discrepancy explicit, do not use the withdrawn paper, and do not infer a signed fixed-centre coefficient-matrix theorem from the generic trilinear or dispersion results.

create.title: Flat prescribed-centre Kloosterman-fraction and dispersion interface obstruction
create.statement_tex: Let R=X/D, K=XL/D^2, Delta=R/K=D/L, F=XK/R, and write every real centre X=N_0+xi. On a frozen flat-smooth strict-UNBAL packet, e(xi k/r) belongs to the uniformly smooth normalized tensor and has O(1) Fourier--Mellin projective mass, so every source phase may use integral N_0 without changing norms. The direct m=1 Bettin--Chandee bound is F^(1/2)(R^(11/10)K^(-3/20)+R), and the direct Wright bound is R^(11/8)F^(1/4); their exponent margins over Delta are respectively greater than 3/10, 1/4, and 5/16. On coprime rows, a=j^2 with j=m=k is an exact inverse connector; the diagonal m^(-1)1_(j=m) has sharp projective norm asymp 1, but the resulting Bettin--Chandee and Wright bounds again exceed Delta by fixed powers. Smooth-weight-first completion is Ramanujan or additive and, after every gcd stratum is restored, returns exactly Delta X^epsilon. Inverse-selector-first completion produces a joint rough coefficient times S(N_0,h;r) and positive cost R sqrt(Delta) X^epsilon. The physical shift has exact residue -N_0 but fails Wright's independent convolution, uniform coprimality, range, principal-term, and absolute-value hypotheses. Bettin--Chandee Corollary 1 accepts (m_1,n_2,m_2,n_1)=(d,r,1,N_0), but its main terms aggregate to Delta X^epsilon and its error per nonzero determinant is X^(3/5+epsilon)R^(17/20). Thus these published interfaces neither improve the accepted flat-wave envelope nor prove the quarter estimate. This is a scoped method obstruction, not a lower bound and not a no-go for a new chi_4-signed joint theorem.
create.next_action: Park direct uses of the audited trilinear, completion, dispersion, and determinant statements. Reopen this packet only with a genuinely new theorem for the literal modulus-dependent coefficient matrix or fixed-centre chi_4-signed scalar that beats min(Delta,sqrt(XL/D)+sqrt(X/(LD))) before positive modulus norms.

The absolute branch Delta has an exact Ramanujan/additive completion, but every audited Kloosterman-fraction and determinant import is no better and none reaches the curvature branch. Any improvement must exploit the actual cross-modulus sign jointly rather than another scalar completion or source norm.

Both the universal positive-energy majorant surface and the standard physical Bettin--Chandee/Wright source-map surface are now parked. Reopen strict UNBAL only for a genuinely new joint chi_4-signed coefficient-matrix or pointwise fixed-centre theorem with a uniform fixed-power gain, or rotate to a distinct unresolved M2 owner after frontier selection.

reject.reason: On the frozen flat cell, buffered log-Fourier separation of the complete profile has O(1) integrated projective mass.
Writing X=N_0+xi and absorbing e(xi k/r) into the uniformly smooth coefficient tensor makes the source frequency integral for every real X.
The direct m=1 map is exact, and on coprime rows m^2 mbar is congruent to m modulo r.
The diagonal matrix m^(-1)1_(j=m) has nuclear and sharp projective norm asymp 1, a factor K^(1/2) above the direct coefficient norm, not K.
Inversion permutes the units, so the complete inverse-only inner sum is Ramanujan; without the coprime restriction it is an ordinary additive delta.
The inversion permutation destroys ordinary Fourier smoothness; only Parseval control remains for the joint modulus-frequency coefficient.
Only inverse-selector-first positive closure has that diagnostic cost. Smooth-weight-first completion exactly returns Delta X^epsilon.
That scalar source bound is legal but redundant; exact Ramanujan or additive evaluation gives the smaller owner-complete Delta capacity.
The exact shifted residue is the fixed integer -N_0; the remaining convolution, coprimality, range, coefficient, and absolute-value mismatches are the true obstructions.
The direct source variable has M=1, so R_0<<M^C forces a bounded fixed factor, and the project modulus family has no common growing divisor.
The project lacks the required independent convolution, uniform coprimality, residue range, principal subtraction, and modulus-by-modulus absolute-discrepancy structure.
Its main terms merely aggregate to Delta X^epsilon and its error per nonzero determinant is X^(3/5+epsilon)R^(17/20).
The result only prices the audited published interfaces after positive norms; it neither proves the literal signed wave large nor rules out a new tailored joint theorem.
No complete flat-UNBAL quarter estimate or downstream M9 dependency was proved.
